theorem partition_bound (color : V → Bool) (S : Finset V)
    (hS : Incidence.Stopping E S) (γ σ τ : ℕ) (hst : σ ≤ τ)
    (hdeg : ∀ v ∈ S, γ ≤ (neighbors E v).card)
    (hov : ∀ v ∈ S, ∀ w ∈ S, v ≠ w →
      overlap E v w ≤ if color v = color w then σ else τ) :
    2 * (γ + σ) ≤ (σ + τ) * S.card := by
  classical
  let P := S.filter (fun w => color w = false)
  let Q := S.filter (fun w => color w = true)
  have hcard : P.card + Q.card = S.card := by
    have h := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := S) (fun w => color w = false)
    simpa [P,Q,Bool.not_eq_false] using h
  have hfalse (v : V) (hv : v ∈ S) (hc : color v = false) :
      γ + σ ≤ σ * P.card + τ * Q.card := by
    have h := column_budget E color S hS γ σ τ hdeg hov v hv
    simpa [hc,P,Q,Bool.not_eq_false] using h
  have htrue (v : V) (hv : v ∈ S) (hc : color v = true) :
      γ + σ ≤ τ * P.card + σ * Q.card := by
    have h := column_budget E color S hS γ σ τ hdeg hov v hv
    simpa [hc,P,Q,Bool.not_eq_true,add_comm] using h
  by_cases hp : P.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := hp
    have hv' := mem_filter.mp hv
    have hb := hfalse v hv'.1 hv'.2
    by_cases hq : Q.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := hq
      have hw' := mem_filter.mp hw
      have hb' := htrue w hw'.1 hw'.2
      nlinarith
    · have hq0 : Q.card = 0 := card_eq_zero.mpr (not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hq)
      nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul_right P.card hst]
  · have hp0 : P.card = 0 := card_eq_zero.mpr (not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hp)
    obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := hS.1
    have hc : color v = true := by
      cases hc : color v
      · have : v ∈ P := mem_filter.mpr ⟨hv,hc⟩
        exact False.elim (hp ⟨v,this⟩)
      · rfl
    have hb := htrue v hv hc
    nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul_right Q.card hst]

theorem positive_family (γ n : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    (hn : 3^γ ≤ n) (heven : Even γ) (hodd : Odd n) :
    let S := support γ n
    (SidonStopping.X (ZMod 2) S * (SidonStopping.X (ZMod 2) S)ᵀ = 0) ∧
    (∀ v, (Finset.univ.filter (fun c => SidonStopping.X (ZMod 2) S c v = 1)).card = γ) ∧
    (∀ c, (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => SidonStopping.X (ZMod 2) S c v = 1)).card = 2*γ) ∧
    (∀ T, Incidence.Stopping (SidonStopping.E S) T → 2*(γ+1) ≤ 3*T.card) ∧
    (SidonStopping.X (ZMod 2) S).mulVec (SidonStopping.leftOnes (G := ZMod n)) = 0 ∧
    (¬ ∃ a, (SidonStopping.X (ZMod 2) S)ᵀ.mulVec a =
      SidonStopping.leftOnes (G := ZMod n)) ∧
    (SidonStopping.X ℝ S * (SidonStopping.X ℝ S)ᵀ =
      SidonStopping.BadX ℝ S * (SidonStopping.BadX ℝ S)ᵀ) := by
  dsimp only
  have hcard := support_card γ n hn
  have he : Even (support γ n).card := by simpa [hcard] using heven
  refine ⟨SidonStopping.css _,?_,?_,?_,SidonStopping.leftOnes_kernel _ he,?_,SidonStopping.gram_equal _⟩
  · intro v; rw [SidonStopping.column_weight,hcard]
  · intro c; rw [SidonStopping.row_weight,hcard]
  · intro T hT
    simpa only [hcard] using SidonStopping.stopping_bound _ (sidon γ n hn) T hT
  · apply SidonStopping.leftOnes_not_stabilizer _ he
    simpa using hodd

theorem quantum_distance_six (h : 39 ∣ n) :
    (HX (n := n) (ZMod 2) * (HZ (n := n) (ZMod 2))ᵀ = 0) ∧
    (∀ x : Var n → ZMod 2, x ≠ 0 → (HX (ZMod 2)).mulVec x = 0 →
      6 ≤ (BinaryStopping.support x).card) ∧
    (HX (ZMod 2)).mulVec (@word n) = 0 ∧
    (¬ ∃ a : Check n → ZMod 2, ((HZ (ZMod 2))ᵀ.mulVec a) = (@word n)) ∧
    (BinaryStopping.support (@word n)).card = 6 :=
  ⟨css,all_nonzero_kernel_weight_ge_six h,word_kernel h,word_not_stabilizer h,word_weight h⟩

theorem gram_only_bound (S : Finset G)
    (lower : Matrix G G ℝ → ℕ)
    (valid_bad : ∀ T : Finset (Bool × G), Incidence.Stopping (badE S) T →
      lower (BadX ℝ S * (BadX ℝ S)ᵀ) ≤ T.card) :
    lower (X ℝ S * (X ℝ S)ᵀ) ≤ 2 := by
  rw [gram_equal]
  have h := valid_bad twin (twin_stopping S)
  simpa [twin_card] using h

theorem unbounded_gram_gap (M t : ℕ) [NeZero (liftLength (2*M) t)]
    (lower : Matrix (ZMod (liftLength (2*M) t)) (ZMod (liftLength (2*M) t)) ℝ → ℝ)
    (valid_bad : ∀ U : Finset (Bool × ZMod (liftLength (2*M) t)),
      Incidence.Stopping (SidonStopping.badE (support (4*M) (liftLength (2*M) t))) U →
      lower (SidonStopping.BadX ℝ (support (4*M) (liftLength (2*M) t)) *
        (SidonStopping.BadX ℝ (support (4*M) (liftLength (2*M) t)))ᵀ) ≤ (U.card : ℝ))
    (T : Finset (Bool × ZMod (liftLength (2*M) t)))
    (hT : Incidence.Stopping (SidonStopping.E (support (4*M) (liftLength (2*M) t))) T) :
    (M:ℝ)*lower (SidonStopping.X ℝ (support (4*M) (liftLength (2*M) t)) *
      (SidonStopping.X ℝ (support (4*M) (liftLength (2*M) t)))ᵀ) < (T.card : ℝ) := by
  have hbound := SidonStopping.real_gram_only_bound _ lower valid_bad
  have hrewrite : 4*M = 2*(2*M) := by omega
  rw [hrewrite] at hT
  have hg := arbitrary_fixed_guarantee (2*M) t T hT
  have hgr : (2*M+1:ℕ) ≤ T.card := hg
  have hrr : (2*(M:ℝ)+1) ≤ (T.card:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hgr
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound (Nat.cast_nonneg M : (0:ℝ) ≤ M)
  linarith

theorem zhu_chugg_negative (h : 39 ∣ n)
    (hgap : eigs (Family.HX (n := n) ℝ) ⟨1,by exact check_count h⟩ < 32) :
    let s := eigs (Family.HX (n := n) ℝ) ⟨1,by exact check_count h⟩
    (2*(n:ℝ))*(8-s)/(32-s) < 0 ∧
    (4*(n:ℝ))*(14-s)/(8*(32-s)) < 0 := by
  dsimp
  have hs := second_lower h
  have hn : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast NeZero.pos n
  constructor
  · apply div_neg_of_neg_of_pos
    · exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by positivity) (by linarith)
    · linarith
  · apply div_neg_of_neg_of_pos
    · exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by positivity) (by linarith)
    · positivity

theorem regular_spectral_bound (E : V → C → Prop) [DecidableRel E] (γ k : ℕ)
    (hcol : ∀ v, (PartitionStopping.neighbors E v).card = γ)
    (hrow : ∀ c, rowWeight E c = k)
    (hmoment : (∑ i,(StoppingSpectral.eigs (H E) i)^2) + (Fintype.card V : ℝ)*γ =
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ)*(γ:ℝ)^2 + (Fintype.card C : ℝ)*(k:ℝ)^2)
    (S : Finset V) (hS : Incidence.Stopping E S) : γ+1 ≤ S.card := by
  apply spectral_stopping_bound E γ (fun v => by rw [hcol]) _ S hS
  simpa only [hcol,hrow,sum_const,card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul] using hmoment

theorem fourth_moment (hn : 3^(2*γ) ≤ n) :
    (∑ i,(eigs (JointSidon.X ℝ (leftMarks γ n) (rightMarks γ n)) i)^2) =
      2*(n:ℝ)*(γ:ℝ)*(3*(γ:ℝ)-1) := by
  have hm := StoppingMoment.moment_of_overlap_one
    (JointSidon.E (leftMarks γ n) (rightMarks γ n))
    (JointSidon.overlap_one _ _ (joint_sidon γ n hn) (disjoint_marks γ n hn))
  rw [real_matrix] at hm
  simp_rw [column_degree hn,row_degree hn] at hm
  simp only [sum_const,card_univ,Fintype.card_prod,Fintype.card_bool,ZMod.card,
    Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_ofNat,nsmul_eq_mul] at hm
  nlinarith

theorem source_stopping_five (hn : 37≤n) (U : Finset (Bool × ZMod n))
    (hU : Incidence.Stopping (fun v c => HX (n := n) (ZMod 2) c v=1) U) : 5≤U.card := by
  refine regular_spectral_bound (E (n := n)) 4 8 (degree hn) (row_degree hn) ?_ U ?_
  · rw [real_matrix,fourth_moment hn]
    simp only [Fintype.card_prod,Fintype.card_bool,ZMod.card,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_ofNat]
    ring
  · simpa only [HX,Incidence.Stopping,JointSidon.binary_incidence] using hU

theorem replacement_value (hn : 37≤n) :
    regularReplacement n (2*n) 4 8 (∑ i,(eigs (HX (n := n) ℝ) i)^2)=5 := by
  rw [fourth_moment hn]
  unfold regularReplacement
  split_ifs with he
  · norm_num
  · exfalso
    apply he
    push_cast
    ring

theorem zhu_chugg_comparison (hgap : eigs HR ⟨1,by decide⟩ < 32) :
    let s := eigs HR ⟨1,by decide⟩
    54*(8-s)/(32-s) < 0 ∧
